description: Locate a natural-language target in the current RGB observation and optionally estimate candidate distances. Applicable to tasks needing candidate locations or target-distance measurements. Returns candidate information, annotated evidence and, when enabled and available, distance estimates. Candidate identity requires interpretation against the task; an empty detection does not prove absence. Distance is camera-to-visible-surface depth, not horizontal or target-center distance.

observation_id.description: Exact observation_id shown on the CURRENT image label.

query.description: Natural-language description of the target to locate.

include_distance.description: true estimates distances to detected candidates; false performs localization without distance estimation.
